The login screen.

  • Lines 39–43: status: the API access layer and messages (read ONCE, [late]: on first use), form submission, data entry (a [Map]: field name -> value), and the received CAPTCHA;
  • lines 59–66: a new image, when the screen opens, upon request, and after EACH attempt (an image is used only once);
  • lines 76–81: both buttons follow this sequence: submission, then, if unsuccessful, the CAPTCHA is cleared and a new image is displayed;
  • lines 86–93: login. If successful, the screen does nothing else: the session changes, and the router, which is listening for it, exits the login screen (see [router.dart]);
  • lines 95–97: “Create a patient account”: the server verifies the CAPTCHA and issues a token (a cookie); the account creation screen then opens;
  • lines 105–106: the screen is reloaded when the submission status changes (in progress, errors);
  • lines 113–129: [AutofillGroup] combines the username and password: the phone’s password manager fills them in together and offers to save the account after login;
  • lines 163–195: demo accounts. [for (final (accounts, roleKey) in [...])]: a loop over a list of records, which are destructured in the process (example 03).

docs.title: 11.13.2. lib/pages/schedule.dart
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// lib/pages/schedule.dart - the schedule screen (/schedule)
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Three blocks, as in the other clients:
//   1. the choice of the doctor and of the day;
//   2. the schedule of this doctor on that day;
//   3. the booking dialog of a slot.
//
// ALL the state of the screen is in its ADDRESS:
//     /schedule?doctorId=1&day=2026-10-05             the schedule
//     /schedule?doctorId=1&day=2026-10-05&book=7      + the booking dialog
// The router passes these three parameters to the widget; the screen DEDUCES
// from them what it displays, and the user's actions change the address
// (context.go, context.push). On the web, we can therefore reload the page,
// bookmark it, use Back / Forward; on the phone, the
// Back button closes the booking dialog.
//
// What each one sees and can do is decided by the SERVER (fields
// patient, mine, bookable, appointmentId of each slot): the screen just
// displays it. A patient does not even receive the name of the other patients.
// =========================================================================

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';

import '../api/api_error.dart';
import '../api/rdvmedecins_api.dart';
import '../api/types.dart';
import '../state/cache.dart';
import '../state/messages.dart';
import '../state/session.dart';
import '../formatting.dart';
import '../i18n/translations.dart';
import '../widgets/confirmation.dart';
import '../widgets/booking_dialog.dart';
import '../widgets/page_title.dart';

// the address of the schedule (without booking dialog, or with)
String scheduleAddress(int? doctorId, String day, [int? book]) => Uri(
  path: '/schedule',
  queryParameters: {'doctorId': '${doctorId ?? ''}', 'day': day, 'book': ?book?.toString()},
).toString();

class SchedulePage extends StatefulWidget {
  final int? doctorId;
  final String? day; // as is in the address: maybe invalid
  final int? book;

  const SchedulePage({super.key, this.doctorId, this.day, this.book});

  @override
  State<SchedulePage> createState() => _SchedulePageState();
}

class _SchedulePageState extends State<SchedulePage> {
  late final _api = context.read<RdvMedecinsApi>();
  late final _cache = context.read<Cache>();
  late final _messages = context.read<Messages>();
  Future<List<Person>>? _doctors;
  List<Person> _clients = [];
  Future<Schedule>? _schedule;
  bool _submitting = false;

  // the day: the one of the address if it is valid, otherwise today
  bool get _invalidDay => widget.day != null && !isValidDate(widget.day!);
  String get _day => widget.day != null && !_invalidDay ? widget.day! : today();

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    final user = context.read<Session>().user;
    _doctors = _cache.read('doctors', () => _api.list(PersonType.doctors));
    // the patients: only for those who are allowed to read them (booking dialog)
    if (user.isManager) {
      _cache.read('clients', () => _api.list(PersonType.clients)).then((c) {
        if (mounted) setState(() => _clients = c);
      }, onError: _messages.showApiError);
    }
    if (_invalidDay) {
      // after the screen is built: we do not change another state during a build
      WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) => _messages.showError('ERRORS.INVALID_DATE'));
    }
    _loadSchedule();
    // invalidated data (booking, cancellation): we read the schedule again.
    // Useful above all for the screen hidden UNDER the booking dialog (see _confirmBooking)
    _cache.addListener(_loadSchedule);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _cache.removeListener(_loadSchedule);
    super.dispose();
  }

  // the router reuses the screen with another address (other doctor, other day)
  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(SchedulePage old) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(old);
    if (old.doctorId != widget.doctorId || old.day != widget.day) _loadSchedule();
  }

  void _loadSchedule() {
    final user = context.read<Session>().user;
    // without a doctor in the address, a DOCTOR sees THEIR schedule (the server
    // finds it from the token); the others see nothing
    final withSchedule = !_invalidDay && (widget.doctorId != null || user?.role == Role.doctor);
    setState(() {
      _schedule = withSchedule
          ? _cache.read('schedule/${widget.doctorId}/$_day', () => _api.schedule(widget.doctorId, _day))
          : null;
    });
    // a failed read: its message, at the bottom of the screen
    _schedule?.then((_) {}, onError: (Object e) => _messages.showApiError(e));
  }

  // the server is the reference: after each action, we read the schedule again
  // (and the patient's area, which shows their appointment). The invalidation
  // notifies all the living schedule screens, including this one (_loadSchedule)
  void _reload() {
    _cache.invalidate('my-area');
    _cache.invalidate('schedule');
  }

  void _closeBooking(int? doctorId) {
    if (context.canPop()) {
      context.pop();
    } else {
      context.go(scheduleAddress(doctorId, _day));
    }
  }

  Future<void> _confirmBooking(ScheduleSlot slot, int? doctorId, int? clientId) async {
    final manager = context.read<Session>().user.isManager;
    setState(() => _submitting = true);
    try {
      await _api.book(_day, slot.id, manager ? clientId : null);
      _messages.flash(key: 'SCHEDULE.BOOKED');
    } on ApiError catch (e) {
      if (e.key == 'ERRORS.CHOOSE_PATIENT') {
        // no patient chosen: the dialog stays open
        _messages.showError(e.key);
        return; // (finally runs all the same)
      }
      // slot taken in the meantime, patient who already has an appointment...: the
      // message will be displayed on the schedule, dialog closed
      _messages.flash(success: false, key: e.key, params: e.params);
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _submitting = false);
    }
    if (!mounted) return;
    _closeBooking(doctorId);
    _reload();
  }

  Future<void> _cancel(ScheduleSlot s) async {
    if (s.appointmentId == null || !await confirm(context, 'SCHEDULE.CANCEL_CONFIRM')) return;
    try {
      await _api.cancelAppointment(s.appointmentId!);
      _messages.showSuccess('SCHEDULE.CANCELLED');
    } on ApiError catch (e) {
      _messages.showApiError(e);
    }
    if (mounted) _reload();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final translations = context.watch<Translations>();
    final t = translations.t;
    final user = context.watch<Session>().user;

    return PageTitle(
      titleKey: 'SCHEDULE.PAGE_TITLE',
      // FutureBuilder: the schedule (null as long as it has not arrived, or if there is none)
      child: FutureBuilder<Schedule>(
        future: _schedule,
        builder: (context, state) {
          final s = state.data;
          // the doctor displayed: the one of the address, or the one of the received schedule (DOCTOR)
          final doctorId = widget.doctorId ?? s?.doctor.id;
          // the slot whose booking dialog is open (&book=7),
          // only if it is bookable by this user
          final toBook = s?.slots.where((c) => c.id == widget.book && c.bookable).firstOrNull;
          // the server's message to the patient who already has an upcoming appointment
          // ("cancel it to book another one") explains nothing if THIS
          // appointment is in the displayed schedule: we see it, under their name,
          // with its "Cancel" button. It is only displayed in the OTHER schedules
          final info = s != null && !s.slots.any((c) => c.mine) ? s.info : null;

          final Widget content;
          if (state.connectionState == ConnectionState.waiting) {
            content = const Padding(
              padding: EdgeInsets.all(24),
              child: Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()),
            );
          } else if (s != null) {
            content = _Schedule(
              schedule: s,
              language: translations.language,
              onBook: (c) => context.push(scheduleAddress(doctorId, _day, c.id)),
              onCancel: _cancel,
            );
          } else {
            content = Padding(padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16), child: Text(t('SCHEDULE.EMPTY_STATE')));
          }

          return Stack(
            children: [
              ListView(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                children: [
                  // 1. the choice of the doctor and of the day. Its key changes with the address:
                  // Flutter then re-creates it, and it starts again from the new values
                  FutureBuilder<List<Person>>(
                    future: _doctors,
                    builder: (context, doctors) => _DoctorDayPicker(
                      key: ValueKey('$doctorId|$_day'),
                      doctors: doctors.data ?? const [],
                      doctorId: doctorId,
                      day: _day,
                      onView: (id, day) => context.go(scheduleAddress(id, day)),
                    ),
                  ),
                  // patient who already has an upcoming appointment: why there is no "Book" button
                  if (info != null)
                    Card(
                      color: Colors.lightBlue.shade50,
                      child: ListTile(
                        title: Text(t(info)),
                        trailing: TextButton(
                          onPressed: () => context.go('/my-area'),
                          child: Text(t('APP.MENU_MY_AREA')),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  content,
                ],
              ),
              // 3. the booking dialog, only if the address contains &book=...
              if (toBook != null)
                BookingDialog(
                  time: timeRange(toBook),
                  clients: _clients,
                  patient: user.isPatient ? user!.name : null,
                  submitting: _submitting,
                  onConfirm: (clientId) => _confirmBooking(toBook, doctorId, clientId),
                  onClose: () => _closeBooking(doctorId),
                ),
            ],
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }
}

// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 1. the choice of the doctor and of the day: a small form, whose state is
// only useful before sending. It STARTS with the values of the address.
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
class _DoctorDayPicker extends StatefulWidget {
  final List<Person> doctors;
  final int? doctorId;
  final String day;
  final void Function(int? doctorId, String day) onView;

  const _DoctorDayPicker({
    super.key,
    required this.doctors,
    required this.doctorId,
    required this.day,
    required this.onView,
  });

  @override
  State<_DoctorDayPicker> createState() => _DoctorDayPickerState();
}

class _DoctorDayPickerState extends State<_DoctorDayPicker> {
  late int? _doctorId = widget.doctorId;
  late String _day = widget.day;

  Future<void> _pickDay() async {
    final choice = await showDatePicker(
      context: context,
      initialDate: DateTime.parse(_day),
      firstDate: DateTime(2020),
      lastDate: DateTime(2035, 12, 31),
    );
    if (choice != null) setState(() => _day = toDay(choice));
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final translations = context.watch<Translations>();
    final t = translations.t;
    // the chosen doctor must be in the list (otherwise: none)
    final knownId = widget.doctors.any((d) => d.id == _doctorId) ? _doctorId : null;
    return Card(
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: [
            DropdownButtonFormField<int?>(
              key: ValueKey('${widget.doctors.length}/$knownId'),
              initialValue: knownId,
              isExpanded: true,
              decoration: InputDecoration(labelText: t('DOCTOR_DAY_PICKER.DOCTOR_LABEL')),
              items: [
                DropdownMenuItem(value: null, child: Text(t('DOCTOR_DAY_PICKER.CHOOSE_DOCTOR'))),
                for (final d in widget.doctors) DropdownMenuItem(value: d.id, child: Text(d.label)),
              ],
              onChanged: (id) => setState(() => _doctorId = id),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            // the day: a button that opens the calendar
            InputDecorator(
              decoration: InputDecoration(labelText: t('DOCTOR_DAY_PICKER.DAY_LABEL')),
              child: InkWell(
                onTap: _pickDay,
                child: Row(
                  children: [
                    Expanded(child: Text(longDate(_day, translations.language))),
                    const Icon(Icons.calendar_month),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            FilledButton(
              onPressed: knownId == null ? null : () => widget.onView(knownId, _day),
              child: Text(t('DOCTOR_DAY_PICKER.VIEW_SCHEDULE')),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 2. the schedule
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
class _Schedule extends StatelessWidget {
  final Schedule schedule;
  final String language;
  final ValueChanged<ScheduleSlot> onBook;
  final ValueChanged<ScheduleSlot> onCancel;

  const _Schedule({required this.schedule, required this.language, required this.onBook, required this.onCancel});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final t = context.watch<Translations>().t;
    final s = schedule;
    return Card(
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: [
            ListTile(
              title: Text(
                '${t('SCHEDULE.TITLE_PREFIX')} ${longDate(s.day, language)}',
                style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
              ),
              subtitle: Text(s.doctor.label),
            ),
            if (s.slots.isEmpty) Padding(padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16), child: Text(t('SCHEDULE.NO_SLOTS'))),
            for (final c in s.slots) ...[
              const Divider(height: 1),
              ListTile(
                // the bookable slots are slightly coloured
                tileColor: c.bookable ? Colors.green.shade50 : null,
                leading: SizedBox(
                  width: 96,
                  child: Text(timeRange(c), style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w500)),
                ),
                title: Align(
                  alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
                  child: c.free
                      ? _Badge(t('SCHEDULE.FREE'), Colors.green.shade700)
                      : c.patient != null
                      ? _Badge(c.patient!.label, c.mine ? Colors.indigo : Colors.grey.shade600)
                      : _Badge(t('SCHEDULE.BOOKED_BY_OTHER'), Colors.grey.shade600),
                ),
                // "Book" changes the ADDRESS (&book=...), which opens the booking dialog
                trailing: c.bookable
                    ? OutlinedButton(onPressed: () => onBook(c), child: Text(t('SCHEDULE.BOOK')))
                    : c.appointmentId != null
                    ? OutlinedButton(
                        style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(foregroundColor: Colors.red.shade700),
                        onPressed: () => onCancel(c),
                        child: Text(t('SCHEDULE.CANCEL_APPOINTMENT')),
                      )
                    : null,
              ),
            ],
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

// a coloured label (the "badge" of the other clients)
class _Badge extends StatelessWidget {
  final String text;
  final Color color;

  const _Badge(this.text, this.color);

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 3),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(color: color, borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6)),
      child: Text(
        text,
        style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
      ),
    );
  }
}

The most feature-rich screen: selecting a doctor and a day, the calendar, and the booking window.

  • lines 40–43: the calendar’s address. The screen’s ENTIRE state is contained in its address; user actions change it, and the screen determines what to display based on that;
  • Lines 66–67: The day from the address, if valid; otherwise, today;
  • lines 70–87: When the screen opens: the doctors (from the cache—they are loaded once for the entire session), the patients if the user has permission to view them (for the booking window), and the calendar. If the date in the address is invalid: a message is displayed AFTER the screen is built ([addPostFrameCallback]: another state is not modified during screen construction). Finally, the screen reads from the cache;
  • lines 98–100: “View schedule” changes the address; the router REUSES the screen (same route) with new parameters: [didUpdateWidget] then re-reads the calendar;
  • lines 103–114: the cache reads the schedule. If there is no doctor listed in the address, a logged-in doctor sees THEIR schedule (the server retrieves it using the token);
  • lines 120–122: After a booking or cancellation, the server’s data takes precedence: the calendar (and the patient’s area) is invalidated; the cache notifies the calendar screens, which reload;
  • lines 125–129: Close the window: return to the previous URL. “Book” PUSHED the URL with [&book=] ([context.push]): it is backtracked ([context.pop]), exactly as the phone’s Back button does. If the screen was opened directly at this address (on the web), there is nothing to backtrack: it goes to the calendar address;
  • lines 133–153: the appointment booking. If no patient is selected, the window remains open, displaying the message. Any other action closes the window, and the message (success or error—such as a time slot being taken in the meantime...) appears as a pop-up message for the calendar. The calendar screen containing the window disappears; the one underneath reappears, thanks to the cache;
  • lines 156–164: cancellation, after confirmation;
  • lines 176–184: the screen displays the calendar ([FutureBuilder]). The time slot in the booking window is that of the address ([&book=7]), only if it is bookable BY THIS USER (a time slot taken in the meantime, a manually created address: no window);
  • line 189: the server sends this message ([info]) along with ALL the calendars; but in the calendar containing the patient’s appointment (a time slot [mine]), it is unnecessary—and even misleading—immediately after a booking: the patient sees their appointment, listed under their name, with a “Cancel” button. Therefore, it is only displayed in the other calendars. [s.slots.any((c) => c.mine)]: true if at least one time slot meets the condition;
  • lines 201–202: “Book” pushes the window’s address;
  • lines 215–222: selection of the doctor and the day. Its key contains the doctor and the day from the URL: when the URL changes (the phone’s Back button, the browser’s Back button), [Flutter] recreates the widget, which starts over with the new values;
  • lines 226–233: a patient who already has an upcoming appointment: why there is no “Book” button (see [info], above);
  • lines 241–248: the booking window, above the calendar (in [Stack]);
  • Lines 280–291: Selection of the doctor and the day: a short form, whose state STARTS with the address values. [late int? _doctorId = widget.doctorId;]: a field initialized from [widget], made possible by [late]. [showDatePicker] opens the calendar from [Material] in the application’s language;
  • lines 319–326: the day is displayed as an input field ([InputDecorator]: the label and border of a field, surrounding any widget), which you tap to open the calendar;
  • lines 346–406: the schedule. One line per time slot: the time, a label (custom text, the patient’s name, or “Booked” for another patient), and the button enabled by the SERVER ([bookable], [appointmentId]).

docs.title: 11.13.3. lib/pages/persons_config.dart
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// lib/pages/persons_config.dart - doctors or clients?
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The management screens of the doctors and of the clients are IDENTICAL: same
// list, same form. We write them ONCE (persons.dart,
// person_form.dart); only the address of the API and the
// keys of the labels change, described here. The router passes the type to each screen.
// =========================================================================

import '../api/rdvmedecins_api.dart';
import '../api/types.dart';

typedef PersonKeys = ({
  String title, // "Doctors"
  String add, // "Add a doctor"
  String edit, // "Edit a doctor"
  String empty, // "No doctors."
  String confirmDelete,
  String added, // "Doctor {{name}} has been added (login: {{login}})."
  String edited,
  String deleted,
  String notFound, // the record has been deleted in the meantime
});

PersonKeys keys(PersonType type) => switch (type) {
  PersonType.doctors => (
    title: 'DOCTORS.TITLE',
    add: 'DOCTORS.ADD',
    edit: 'DOCTORS.EDIT',
    empty: 'DOCTORS.EMPTY',
    confirmDelete: 'DOCTORS.DELETE_CONFIRM',
    added: 'DOCTORS.ADDED',
    edited: 'DOCTORS.UPDATED',
    deleted: 'DOCTORS.DELETED',
    notFound: 'ERRORS.DOCTOR_NOT_FOUND',
  ),
  PersonType.clients => (
    title: 'CLIENTS.TITLE',
    add: 'CLIENTS.ADD',
    edit: 'CLIENTS.EDIT',
    empty: 'CLIENTS.EMPTY',
    confirmDelete: 'CLIENTS.DELETE_CONFIRM',
    added: 'CLIENTS.ADDED',
    edited: 'CLIENTS.UPDATED',
    deleted: 'CLIENTS.DELETED',
    notFound: 'ERRORS.PATIENT_NOT_FOUND',
  ),
};

// {{name}} and {{login}} of the "added / updated / deleted" messages
Map<String, String> messageParams(Person p) => {'name': '${p.firstName} ${p.lastName}', 'login': p.login ?? ''};

The screens for doctors and clients are identical; only the label keys, described here, differ.

  • lines 13–22: a record with named fields, which contains the keys for a type of person;
  • lines 25–37: an expression on an enumeration: [Dart] ensures that all cases are handled. Adding a value to [PersonType] would cause a compilation error here;
  • line 51: the parameters for the “added,” “modified,” and “deleted” messages.

docs.title: 11.13.4. lib/pages/persons.dart
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// lib/pages/persons.dart - the list of the doctors OR of the clients (ADMIN)
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// One screen for both: the type (doctors or clients) arrives as a
// parameter (see router.dart); the labels specific to each one are in
// persons_config.dart.
// On a phone, a five-column table does not fit: one list line
// per person (name, login), with its two buttons; the round button
// "+" (FloatingActionButton) adds a person.
// =========================================================================

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';

import '../api/api_error.dart';
import '../api/rdvmedecins_api.dart';
import '../api/types.dart';
import '../state/cache.dart';
import '../state/messages.dart';
import '../i18n/translations.dart';
import '../widgets/confirmation.dart';
import '../widgets/page_title.dart';
import 'persons_config.dart';

class PersonsPage extends StatefulWidget {
  final PersonType type;

  const PersonsPage({super.key, required this.type});

  @override
  State<PersonsPage> createState() => _PersonsPageState();
}

class _PersonsPageState extends State<PersonsPage> {
  late final _api = context.read<RdvMedecinsApi>();
  late final _cache = context.read<Cache>();
  late final _messages = context.read<Messages>();
  Future<List<Person>>? _list;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _load();
  }

  // the router reuses the screen for the other type (/doctors -> /clients)
  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(PersonsPage old) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(old);
    if (old.type != widget.type) _load();
  }

  void _load() {
    final type = widget.type;
    setState(() {
      _list = _cache.read(type.name, () => _api.list(type));
    });
    _list!.then((_) {}, onError: (Object e) => _messages.showApiError(e));
  }

  Future<void> _delete(Person p) async {
    final k = keys(widget.type);
    if (!await confirm(context, k.confirmDelete)) return;
    try {
      await _api.remove(widget.type, p.id);
      _messages.showSuccess(k.deleted, messageParams(p));
    } on ApiError catch (e) {
      // a doctor who still has appointments: 409 ERRORS.DOCTOR_HAS_APPOINTMENTS
      _messages.showApiError(e);
    }
    _cache.invalidate(widget.type.name);
    if (mounted) _load();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final t = context.watch<Translations>().t;
    final k = keys(widget.type);
    final type = widget.type.name;
    return PageTitle(
      titleKey: k.title,
      // a Scaffold IN the layout: for its floating button
      child: Scaffold(
        floatingActionButton: FloatingActionButton.extended(
          onPressed: () => context.go('/$type/add'),
          icon: const Icon(Icons.add),
          label: Text(t(k.add)),
        ),
        body: FutureBuilder<List<Person>>(
          future: _list,
          builder: (context, state) {
            final list = state.data;
            if (list == null) {
              // not loaded yet (or failed load: the message is at the bottom of the screen)
              return state.hasError ? const SizedBox.shrink() : const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
            }
            return ListView(
              // room at the bottom, so as not to hide the last line under the floating button
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(8, 8, 8, 88),
              children: [
                Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
                  child: Text(t(k.title), style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.headlineSmall),
                ),
                if (list.isEmpty) ListTile(title: Text(t(k.empty))),
                for (final p in list)
                  Card(
                    child: ListTile(
                      leading: CircleAvatar(child: Text('${p.firstName[0]}${p.lastName[0]}')),
                      title: Text(p.label),
                      subtitle: Text(p.login ?? '', style: const TextStyle(fontFamily: 'RobotoMono')),
                      trailing: Row(
                        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                        children: [
                          IconButton(
                            tooltip: t('PERSONS.EDIT'),
                            icon: const Icon(Icons.edit),
                            onPressed: () => context.go('/$type/${p.id}/edit'),
                          ),
                          IconButton(
                            tooltip: t('PERSONS.DELETE'),
                            icon: Icon(Icons.delete_outline, color: Colors.red.shade700),
                            onPressed: () => _delete(p),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
              ],
            );
          },
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

The list of doctors or clients.

  • lines 54–59: the list, from the cache. Be careful with the curly braces in [setState(() { ... })]: written with an arrow, [setState(() => _list = ...)], the function WOULD RETURN the assigned value, in this case a [Future], and [setState] rejects a function that returns a [Future] (the status update must be synchronous): [Flutter] signals this with an error;
  • lines 62–73: deletion, after confirmation. A doctor with appointments is rejected by the server (409 [DOCTOR_HAS_APPOINTMENTS]);
  • lines 84–88: a [Scaffold] within the layout’s [Scaffold], for its floating “+ Add” button ([FloatingActionButton]) in the lower right corner;
  • lines 107–124: one list item per person ([ListTile]): an avatar with their initials, name, username, and two buttons. A five-column table, such as the one for web clients, would not fit on a phone.

docs.title: 11.13.5. lib/pages/person_form.dart
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// lib/pages/person_form.dart - creation OR update of a
// doctor or of a client (ADMIN)
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
//     /doctors/add               -> creation (no id)
//     /doctors/3/edit            -> update (id = 3)
// (and the same addresses under /clients).
//
// Two widgets:
//   - PersonFormPage reads the record to update (if there is one);
//   - _Form is only displayed once the record has been read: it STARTS with
//     its values (initial state), without having to copy them later.
// No rule is checked here: the server validates everything, and its errors
// are displayed under the fields (see widgets/form_submit.dart).
// The VERSION read with the record goes back with the update: if another
// ADMIN has changed it in the meantime, the server responds 409 CONCURRENT_UPDATE.
// =========================================================================

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';

import '../api/api_error.dart';
import '../api/rdvmedecins_api.dart';
import '../api/types.dart';
import '../state/cache.dart';
import '../state/messages.dart';
import '../i18n/translations.dart';
import '../widgets/input_field.dart';
import '../widgets/person_fields.dart';
import '../widgets/form_submit.dart';
import '../widgets/page_title.dart';
import 'persons_config.dart';

const _empty = <String, Object?>{'title': 'Mr', 'firstName': '', 'lastName': '', 'login': '', 'password': ''};

class PersonFormPage extends StatefulWidget {
  final PersonType type;
  final int? id; // null: creation

  const PersonFormPage({super.key, required this.type, this.id});

  @override
  State<PersonFormPage> createState() => _PersonFormPageState();
}

class _PersonFormPageState extends State<PersonFormPage> {
  Future<Person>? _details;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    final id = widget.id;
    if (id != null) {
      // update: we read the record (including its version), WITHOUT cache: it
      // must be up to date (otherwise the form would start with an out-of-date
      // version: 409 CONCURRENT_UPDATE)
      _details = context.read<RdvMedecinsApi>().read(widget.type, id);
      // record that does not exist (deleted in the meantime...): back to the list
      _details!.then(
        (_) {},
        onError: (Object e) {
          if (e is! ApiError || !mounted) return;
          context.read<Messages>().flash(success: false, key: e.key, params: e.params);
          context.go('/${widget.type.name}');
        },
      );
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final k = keys(widget.type);
    return PageTitle(
      titleKey: widget.id == null ? k.add : k.edit,
      child: widget.id == null
          ? _Form(type: widget.type, id: null, initial: _empty)
          : FutureBuilder<Person>(
              future: _details,
              builder: (context, state) {
                final p = state.data;
                if (p == null) return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
                return _Form(
                  type: widget.type,
                  id: p.id,
                  initial: {
                    'title': p.title,
                    'firstName': p.firstName,
                    'lastName': p.lastName,
                    'login': p.login ?? '',
                    'password': '',
                    'version': p.version,
                  },
                );
              },
            ),
    );
  }
}

// the form itself
class _Form extends StatefulWidget {
  final PersonType type;
  final int? id;
  final Map<String, Object?> initial;

  const _Form({required this.type, required this.id, required this.initial});

  @override
  State<_Form> createState() => _FormState();
}

class _FormState extends State<_Form> {
  late final _messages = context.read<Messages>();
  late final _submit = FormSubmit(_messages);
  // a modifiable COPY of the initial values
  late final Map<String, Object?> _input = {...widget.initial};

  bool get _creating => widget.id == null;

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _submit.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _edit(String field, String value) {
    setState(() => _input[field] = value);
    _submit.clearError(field);
  }

  Future<void> _save() async {
    final api = context.read<RdvMedecinsApi>();
    final cache = context.read<Cache>();
    final k = keys(widget.type);
    final succeeded = await _submit.submit(() async {
      final id = widget.id;
      final p = id == null ? await api.add(widget.type, _input) : await api.edit(widget.type, id, _input);
      _messages.flash(key: _creating ? k.added : k.edited, params: messageParams(p));
    });
    if (!mounted) return;
    final errorKey = _messages.error?.key;
    if (succeeded) {
      cache.invalidate(widget.type.name); // the list has changed
      context.go('/${widget.type.name}');
    } else if (errorKey == k.notFound) {
      // deleted in the meantime by another ADMIN: back to the list
      _messages.flash(success: false, key: errorKey!);
      context.go('/${widget.type.name}');
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final t = context.watch<Translations>().t;
    final k = keys(widget.type);
    return ListenableBuilder(
      listenable: _submit,
      builder: (context, _) => ListView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        children: [
          Text(t(_creating ? k.add : k.edit), style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.headlineSmall),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          PersonFields(values: _input, errors: _submit.errors, onChanged: _edit),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          Text(t('PERSONS.ACCOUNT_SECTION'), style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleSmall),
          InputField(
            label: 'PERSONS.LOGIN_LABEL',
            maxLength: 30,
            value: _input['login'] as String,
            onChanged: (v) => _edit('login', v),
            error: _submit.errors['login'],
            help: _creating ? 'PERSONS.LOGIN_HELP_CREATE' : 'PERSONS.LOGIN_HELP_EDIT',
          ),
          // never pre-filled: the password never comes back from the server
          InputField(
            label: 'PERSONS.PASSWORD_LABEL',
            secret: true,
            maxLength: 72,
            value: _input['password'] as String,
            onChanged: (v) => _edit('password', v),
            error: _submit.errors['password'],
            params: _submit.params,
            help: _creating ? 'PERSONS.PASSWORD_HELP_CREATE' : 'PERSONS.PASSWORD_HELP_EDIT',
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          Wrap(
            spacing: 8,
            children: [
              FilledButton(onPressed: _submit.submitting ? null : _save, child: Text(t('PERSONS.SAVE'))),
              OutlinedButton(onPressed: () => context.go('/${widget.type.name}'), child: Text(t('PERSONS.BACK'))),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

Adding or modifying a doctor or a client.

  • lines 54–65: To make a change, the record is read; WITHOUT cache: its version must be up to date. If a record cannot be found (deleted in the meantime): return to the list with a message;
  • lines 78–92: The form is displayed only after the record has been read, and STARTS with its values; the user never has to re-enter them later;
  • line 117: a modifiable COPY of the initial values ([...]: the decomposition operator, within a [Map]);
  • lines 132–149: the record: [POST] or [PUT], depending on whether there is an identifier. The success message is a flash message: it will appear on the list. If a record has been deleted in the meantime by another ADMIN: return to the list;
  • lines 167–184: the username and password, with different help messages for creation and modification (leaving the password field blank does not change the password). The password is never pre-filled: the server never returns it.

// =========================================================================
// lib/pages/register.dart - "Create a patient account" (/register)
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// We only get here after having copied the captcha of the login screen
// (button "Create a patient account"): the server has then issued a
// pass (a cookie), which the guard of the route has checked (see
// router.dart). Same fields as the ADMIN's form, but the login
// and the password are required, with confirmation.
// =========================================================================

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';

import '../api/rdvmedecins_api.dart';
import '../state/messages.dart';
import '../i18n/translations.dart';
import '../widgets/input_field.dart';
import '../widgets/person_fields.dart';
import '../widgets/form_submit.dart';
import '../widgets/page_title.dart';

// minimum length of a password chosen by a patient: same value
// as the server (which also sends back {min} with the PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT error)
const passwordMin = '6';

class RegisterPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const RegisterPage({super.key});

  @override
  State<RegisterPage> createState() => _RegisterPageState();
}

class _RegisterPageState extends State<RegisterPage> {
  late final _messages = context.read<Messages>();
  late final _submit = FormSubmit(_messages);
  final Map<String, Object?> _input = {
    'title': 'Mr',
    'firstName': '',
    'lastName': '',
    'login': '',
    'password': '',
    'confirmation': '',
  };

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _submit.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _edit(String field, String value) {
    setState(() => _input[field] = value);
    _submit.clearError(field);
  }

  Future<void> _create() async {
    final api = context.read<RdvMedecinsApi>();
    var login = '';
    final succeeded = await _submit.submit(() async => login = await api.register(_input));
    if (!mounted) return;
    if (succeeded) {
      // back to the login screen, login pre-filled
      _messages.flash(key: 'REGISTRATION.DONE', params: {'login': login});
      context.go(Uri(path: '/login', queryParameters: {'login': login}).toString());
    } else if (_messages.error?.key == 'ERRORS.CAPTCHA_BEFORE_ACCOUNT') {
      // pass expired (15 minutes): back to the captcha
      _messages.flash(success: false, key: 'ERRORS.CAPTCHA_BEFORE_ACCOUNT');
      context.go('/login');
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final t = context.watch<Translations>().t;
    // the parameters of the help message AND of the password errors
    final passwordParams = {'min': passwordMin, ..._submit.params};
    return PageTitle(
      titleKey: 'REGISTRATION.TITLE',
      child: ListenableBuilder(
        listenable: _submit,
        builder: (context, _) => ListView(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
          children: [
            Text(t('REGISTRATION.TITLE'), style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.headlineSmall),
            Text(t('REGISTRATION.INTRO'), style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.grey)),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            PersonFields(values: _input, errors: _submit.errors, onChanged: _edit),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            Text(t('PERSONS.ACCOUNT_SECTION'), style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleSmall),
            InputField(
              label: 'PERSONS.LOGIN_LABEL',
              maxLength: 30,
              value: _input['login'] as String,
              onChanged: (v) => _edit('login', v),
              error: _submit.errors['login'],
              help: 'REGISTRATION.LOGIN_HELP',
              autofill: const [AutofillHints.newUsername],
            ),
            InputField(
              label: 'PERSONS.PASSWORD_LABEL',
              secret: true,
              maxLength: 72,
              value: _input['password'] as String,
              onChanged: (v) => _edit('password', v),
              error: _submit.errors['password'],
              params: passwordParams,
              help: 'REGISTRATION.PASSWORD_HELP',
              autofill: const [AutofillHints.newPassword],
            ),
            InputField(
              label: 'ACCOUNT.CONFIRMATION_LABEL',
              secret: true,
              maxLength: 72,
              value: _input['confirmation'] as String,
              onChanged: (v) => _edit('confirmation', v),
              error: _submit.errors['confirmation'],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            Wrap(
              spacing: 8,
              children: [
                FilledButton(onPressed: _submit.submitting ? null : _create, child: Text(t('REGISTRATION.SUBMIT'))),
                OutlinedButton(onPressed: () => context.go('/login'), child: Text(t('REGISTRATION.BACK_TO_LOGIN'))),
              ],
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

Creating a patient account, accessible with the pass issued by the login screen (see the route's guard in [router.dart]).

  • line 25: the minimum password length; for the help message: the same value as the server (which also returns it with error [PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT]);
  • Lines 57–69: Creation. Successful: returns to the login screen, with the username pre-filled ([/login?login=...]), along with a pop-up message. Failed because the pass has expired (15 minutes): returns to the CAPTCHA. Any other error remains displayed below the fields;
  • line 77: the parameters for the help message and the password error ([{{min}}]);
  • lines 98–109: a NEW account: the password manager can suggest a strong password and save it.

docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// lib/pages/patient_area.dart - "My area" (/my-area, USER role)
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The patient's home screen, just after logging in:
//   - two options: [Manage my account] and [View a schedule];
//   - their upcoming appointment, if they have one, with the means to cancel it.
// =========================================================================

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';

import '../api/api_error.dart';
import '../api/rdvmedecins_api.dart';
import '../api/types.dart';
import '../state/cache.dart';
import '../state/messages.dart';
import '../formatting.dart';
import '../i18n/translations.dart';
import '../widgets/confirmation.dart';
import '../widgets/page_title.dart';
import 'schedule.dart';

class PatientAreaPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const PatientAreaPage({super.key});

  @override
  State<PatientAreaPage> createState() => _PatientAreaPageState();
}

class _PatientAreaPageState extends State<PatientAreaPage> {
  late final _api = context.read<RdvMedecinsApi>();
  late final _cache = context.read<Cache>();
  late final _messages = context.read<Messages>();
  Future<MyArea>? _area;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _load();
  }

  void _load() {
    // braces: an arrow function WOULD RETURN the assigned Future, and
    // setState refuses a function that returns a Future
    setState(() {
      _area = _cache.read('my-area', _api.myArea);
    });
    _area!.then((_) {}, onError: (Object e) => _messages.showApiError(e));
  }

  Future<void> _cancel(int appointmentId) async {
    if (!await confirm(context, 'SCHEDULE.CANCEL_CONFIRM')) return;
    try {
      await _api.cancelAppointment(appointmentId);
      _messages.showSuccess('SCHEDULE.CANCELLED');
    } on ApiError catch (e) {
      _messages.showApiError(e);
    }
    // the area AND the schedules have changed
    _cache.invalidate('my-area');
    _cache.invalidate('schedule');
    if (mounted) _load();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final translations = context.watch<Translations>();
    final t = translations.t;
    return PageTitle(
      titleKey: 'AREA.TITLE',
      child: FutureBuilder<MyArea>(
        future: _area,
        builder: (context, state) {
          final a = state.data;
          if (a == null) return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
          return ListView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
            children: [
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(4),
                child: Text(
                  t('AREA.HELLO', {'name': a.patient.label}),
                  style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.headlineSmall,
                ),
              ),
              _Option(
                icon: Icons.manage_accounts,
                title: t('AREA.MANAGE_ACCOUNT'),
                help: t('AREA.MANAGE_ACCOUNT_HELP'),
                onTap: () => context.go('/my-account'),
              ),
              _Option(
                icon: Icons.calendar_month,
                title: t('AREA.VIEW_SCHEDULE'),
                help: t('AREA.VIEW_SCHEDULE_HELP'),
                onTap: () => context.go('/schedule'),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              Card(
                child: Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [
                      Text(t('AREA.MY_APPOINTMENT'), style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium),
                      // normally only one (rule "one upcoming appointment at a
                      // time"), but the screen can display several
                      for (final ap in a.appointments) ...[
                        const SizedBox(height: 8),
                        Text(
                          '${longDate(ap.day, translations.language)}, ${timeRange(ap.slot)}',
                          style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
                        ),
                        Text(ap.doctor.label),
                        Wrap(
                          spacing: 8,
                          children: [
                            // the doctor's schedule on that day: the patient sees their name in it
                            TextButton(
                              onPressed: () => context.go(scheduleAddress(ap.doctor.id, ap.day)),
                              child: Text(t('AREA.SEE_IN_SCHEDULE')),
                            ),
                            OutlinedButton(
                              style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(foregroundColor: Colors.red.shade700),
                              onPressed: () => _cancel(ap.id),
                              child: Text(t('AREA.CANCEL_APPOINTMENT')),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ],
                      if (a.appointments.isEmpty)
                        Padding(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 8),
                          child: Text(t('AREA.NO_APPOINTMENT'), style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.grey)),
                        ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }
}

// an option "card", which you tap to open a screen
class _Option extends StatelessWidget {
  final IconData icon;
  final String title;
  final String help;
  final VoidCallback onTap;

  const _Option({required this.icon, required this.title, required this.help, required this.onTap});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Card(
      child: ListTile(
        leading: Icon(icon, size: 32, color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.primary),
        title: Text(title, style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium),
        subtitle: Text(help),
        trailing: const Icon(Icons.chevron_right),
        onTap: onTap,
      ),
    );
  }
}

The patient’s home screen: two options, and their upcoming appointment.

  • lines 52–63: Canceling the appointment: the area AND the schedules have changed;
  • Lines 109–127: the appointment, and two buttons: view the doctor’s schedule for that day (the patient sees their name there), cancel;
  • lines 150–166: an option: a card that you tap to open a screen.

docs.title: 11.13.8. lib/pages/my_account.dart
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// lib/pages/my_account.dart - "Manage my account" (/my-account, USER role)
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Two independent forms:
//   1. the update (identity, login, optional new password);
//   2. the deletion of the account - which also cancels its appointments.
// Both require the CURRENT password (checked by the server).
// Two forms, hence two FormSubmit (two sets of errors). As
// for the persons form, the update is only displayed once
// the account has been read, and starts with its values.
// =========================================================================

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';

import '../api/rdvmedecins_api.dart';
import '../api/types.dart';
import '../state/cache.dart';
import '../state/messages.dart';
import '../state/session.dart';
import '../i18n/translations.dart';
import '../widgets/input_field.dart';
import '../widgets/person_fields.dart';
import '../widgets/confirmation.dart';
import '../widgets/form_submit.dart';
import '../widgets/page_title.dart';

class MyAccountPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const MyAccountPage({super.key});

  @override
  State<MyAccountPage> createState() => _MyAccountPageState();
}

class _MyAccountPageState extends State<MyAccountPage> {
  // read again at each visit, without cache: its version must be up to date
  late final Future<MyAccount> _account = context.read<RdvMedecinsApi>().myAccount();

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return PageTitle(
      titleKey: 'MY_ACCOUNT.TITLE',
      child: ListView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
        children: [
          FutureBuilder<MyAccount>(
            future: _account,
            builder: (context, state) => state.hasData
                ? _Update(account: state.data!)
                : const Padding(
                    padding: EdgeInsets.all(24),
                    child: Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()),
                  ),
          ),
          const _Deletion(),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 1. the update
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
class _Update extends StatefulWidget {
  final MyAccount account;

  const _Update({required this.account});

  @override
  State<_Update> createState() => _UpdateState();
}

class _UpdateState extends State<_Update> {
  late final _messages = context.read<Messages>();
  late final _submit = FormSubmit(_messages);
  late final Map<String, Object?> _input = {
    'title': widget.account.title,
    'firstName': widget.account.firstName,
    'lastName': widget.account.lastName,
    'login': widget.account.login,
    'password': '',
    'confirmation': '',
    'currentPassword': '',
    'version': widget.account.version,
  };

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _submit.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _edit(String field, String value) {
    setState(() => _input[field] = value);
    _submit.clearError(field);
  }

  Future<void> _save() async {
    final api = context.read<RdvMedecinsApi>();
    final session = context.read<Session>();
    final cache = context.read<Cache>();
    final succeeded = await _submit.submit(() async {
      // the server has issued a NEW token (name, login): the top bar must follow
      session.update(await api.editMyAccount(_input));
      _messages.flash(key: 'MY_ACCOUNT.UPDATED');
    });
    if (!mounted) return;
    if (succeeded) {
      cache.invalidate('my-area');
      context.go('/my-area');
    } else {
      // never a password left in the field after a refused submission;
      // we change the value WITHOUT going through _edit(), so as not to clear
      // the error that the server has just attached to it
      setState(() => _input['currentPassword'] = '');
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final t = context.watch<Translations>().t;
    return ListenableBuilder(
      listenable: _submit,
      builder: (context, _) => Card(
        child: Padding(

              const SizedBox(height: 12),

              InputField(
                label: 'PERSONS.LOGIN_LABEL',

                error: _submit.errors['login'],
              ),
              InputField(

                secret: true,
                maxLength: 72,

                onChanged: (v) => _edit('password', v),
                error: _submit.errors['password'],
                params: _submit.params,
                help: 'PERSONS.PASSWORD_HELP_EDIT',
              ),
              InputField(

                maxLength: 72,

                error: _submit.errors['currentPassword'],

                  FilledButton(onPressed: _submit.submitting ? null : _save, child: Text(t('PERSONS.SAVE'))),
                  OutlinedButton(onPressed: () => context.go('/my-area'), child: Text(t('MY_ACCOUNT.BACK'))),

// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 2. the deletion: a form with a single field
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
class _Deletion extends StatefulWidget {
  const _Deletion();

  @override
  State<_Deletion> createState() => _DeletionState();
}

class _DeletionState extends State<_Deletion> {
  late final _messages = context.read<Messages>();
  late final _submit = FormSubmit(_messages);
  String _currentPassword = '';

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _submit.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _delete() async {
    final api = context.read<RdvMedecinsApi>();
    final session = context.read<Session>();
    if (!await confirm(context, 'MY_ACCOUNT.DELETE_CONFIRM')) return;
    final succeeded = await _submit.submit(() => api.deleteMyAccount(_currentPassword));
    if (succeeded) {
      // the message first: it will be displayed on the login screen, where the
      // router takes us as soon as the session is empty
      _messages.flash(key: 'MY_ACCOUNT.DELETED');
      session.forget(voluntary: true); // the server has cleared the token cookie
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final t = context.watch<Translations>().t;
    return ListenableBuilder(
      listenable: _submit,
      builder: (context, _) => Card(
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
          side: BorderSide(color: Colors.red.shade300),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        ),
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
            children: [
              Text(
                t('MY_ACCOUNT.DELETE_TITLE'),
                style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleLarge!.copyWith(color: Colors.red.shade700),
              ),
              Text(t('MY_ACCOUNT.DELETE_HELP'), style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.grey)),
              InputField(
                label: 'MY_ACCOUNT.CURRENT_PASSWORD_LABEL',
                secret: true,
                maxLength: 72,
                value: _currentPassword,
                onChanged: (v) {
                  setState(() => _currentPassword = v);
                  _submit.clearError('currentPassword');
                },
                error: _submit.errors['currentPassword'],
              ),
              Align(
                alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
                child: FilledButton(
                  style: FilledButton.styleFrom(backgroundColor: Colors.red.shade700),
                  onPressed: _submit.submitting ? null : _delete,
                  child: Text(t('MY_ACCOUNT.DELETE_SUBMIT')),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

“Manage My Account”: two independent forms, each with its own [FormSubmit].

  • line 38: the account, reloaded on every visit, without caching (its version must be up to date);
  • lines 100–117: the modification. The server returns the updated user (and a new token in their cookie): the session is updated, and the name displayed in the menu is updated accordingly. After a rejection, the current password is cleared from the field;
  • lines 207–216: account deletion, after confirmation. First, the message (a pop-up message); then the session is cleared, and the router displays the login screen, along with the message.
